Most cloud migrations I've worked on don't stall from Kubernetes or databases.

They stall because multi-subscription governance wasn't locked in on Day 1.

Automating policy guardrails in Terraform before onboarding devs saved us months of rework. #Azure #PlatformEngineering

CI/CD pipelines shouldn't just run unit tests; they should enforce architecture guardrails.

In our GitHub Actions, we reject PRs that introduce unpinned dependencies or drift from Bicep landing zone specs before code review starts. #DevOps

The secret to Platform Engineering:
Don't build an internal developer portal nobody asked for.

Find the 3 manual tickets filed every week (secret rotation, staging DB, preview envs) and automate them into a self-service CLI. #PlatformEngineering
